name: personal-news-terminal
description: Zero-maintenance, self-updating Bloomberg-terminal-style personal news dashboard. GitHub Actions fetches RSS feeds and commits data.json; GitHub Pages serves the static site.

scripts.test: node -e "const d=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('data.json','utf8')); if(!d||!d.categories||!Object.keys(d.categories).length)throw new Error('data.json missing categories'); console.log('data.json OK —', Object.keys(d.categories).join(', '))"
